question: Is the Kingdom of the Algarve a distinct territorial actor at 1756-08-01, or part of pol_portugal?
comparison_case: MAPGEN-009 kept Naples and Sicily apart because each had its own parliament, its own council and its own viceroy. The Algarve has none of the three, and its ground is run by corregedores of two ordinary comarcas under the same Ordenações as Beira or Alentejo.
consequence: hsub_portugal_crown_iberian_mainland's scope now includes the Algarve; no new polity is created; the Algarve is removed from the withheld special-case list.
